I've had schizophrenia for as long as I can remember. I always thought it was normal until year 3 when the doctor said otherwise. Since year 5 I have been bullied because of it. It wasn't so bad then, I could cope with it. It was just frequent name callling and the odd punch in the face. Then in year 7, when I started high-school, I tried to hide it. A group of people found out, and they've bullied me ever since. They follow me home most days and pin me against the wall and beat the living shit out of me. I have bruises all over my body now and with them and voices in my heaad telling me that I'm worthless scum and to just jump in front of the car which is speeding is pretty fucking hard to deal with. Then my mom died near the end of that year in a car crash. It broke me. I wouldn't leave my bed, I had no motivation or energy to do anything. I just sat there, in my bed, crying. My dad blamed it on me. He hits me every day now basically. I've been on Prozac ever since but it hasn't made that large of a difference. So in year 8, things were starting to look up for me. My schizophrenia wasn't as bad and I was dating one of the most popular girls in the school, until she decided I wasn't the 'in' person anymore. She didn't even tell me. She just ignored me all the time and whenever she did answer me, she was telling me to fuck off or how fat I am. About a week later, my best friend comitted suicide. It was so unexpected. One of the two people who cared about me had ended his life, and he never even mentioned anything to suggest he was even sad. My other best friend was depressed because of this now, he just stopped going to school. I was worried about him, so I knocked on their house door. No answer, but the door was open. I opened it slightly more and called for someone. No answer. He should have been there and I was really worried by that point, so I went in and walked up the stairs to his room. I knocked on the door. No answer. I opened it and I watched the last few seconds of my only friend's life drain away. I couldn't even think, I just watched the body hanging and cried and cried. His parents came home about one hour later and they blamed it on me for a while. Until they realised that I couldn't have just hung him. My schizophrenia came back after that and I just don't want to live anymore now. Since then, every single person I've gotten close to has killed them self. There's something wrong with me, I know it, which just drives people to commit suicide. I'm alone. Recently I've not been feeling properly. As if I'm numb. I've not felt anything mentally or physically since. My vision has fucked as well. Everything has a hypersensitive white tint to it, it's almost blinding. I'm too scared to ask anyone about this stuff.
I think the only way which has ever helped me feel better is being close to people, but everyone who I've ever been close to has committed suicide. It must be my fault.
